novelty_search.nearest_positive: Program v11 identifies initial resid10 as an operational variable group; the final-resid18 affine controller predicts new lexicon and has a calibrated dose response.
novelty_search.nearest_boundary: The validated controller reads final-resid18 has/had confidence and therefore does not yet specify the upstream computation that sets gain.
novelty_search.new_question: Can a four-parameter map from fixed has/had confidence at upstream resid10 compute the later rank-one carrier gain and preserve prospective causal performance?

frozen_design.calibration_rows: The immutable 16 lexical row IDs tagged selection in the scalar-term result; eight per direction across A1/A2.
frozen_design.calibration_response: The immutable v10 target-guided alpha for each calibration row.
frozen_design.feature: At resid:10 of the base calibration state or confirmation source state, fixed current-tense token logit minus other-tense token logit using has=468 and had=550.
frozen_design.fit: Separate ordinary least-squares intercept+slope per direction, four float64 coefficients total; no ridge, clipping, grid, or confirmation data.
frozen_design.confirmation_population: The sealed 64-row prospective lexicon v3 population already used to establish the final-margin controller; resid10 features and interventions have not been inspected.
frozen_design.actuator: alpha = intercept[direction] + slope[direction]*resid10_confidence; patch resid18_source + alpha*q. Confirmation resid18 has/had margin, donor activation, row outcome IDs, and outcomes do not select alpha.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_capability_an: All hashes and row alignments pass; exact-head replay passes at resid10 and resid18; inherited confirmation source capability is rechecked on scored resid18 sides.
predictions.pred_b_upstream_fit_and_actuator_well_fo: Each direction has eight nondegenerate calibration features, finite OLS coefficients, calibration R^2>=0.50, and every confirmation alpha uses only resid10 source state, direction, fixed IDs, and those four coefficients.
predictions.pred_c_new_lexicon_A_prediction: A1 and A2 each have mean recovery >=0.75, direction fraction >=0.75, and at least 0.65 of the final-margin prospective recovery.
predictions.pred_d_new_lexicon_P_generalization: P mean reflection >=0.75, direction fraction >=0.75, and at least 0.65 of the final-margin prospective reflection.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: Exactly 16 calibration rows and 64 unique confirmation rows fit four parameters within 25 counted forwards, 368 example evaluations, 240 selected-head pair evaluations, zero grids/backwards/updates, and 64 intervention records.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: a tested v11 upstream variable computes a lexicon-held-out calibrated carrier write through a four-parameter map.
terminal.null: Authority and coverage pass but upstream fit, A/P prediction, or C selectivity misses; final-margin feedback remains necessary under this scalar upstream interface.
terminal.invalid: Authority, alignment, capability, exact-head control, fit degeneracy, actuator identity, or coverage fails.
